kind: local proof-of-concept evidence: tiered, bucketed txid display publication on synthetic journals
deployment: none; no production host was read for data or changed

source.run1: pre-rebase handoff source before 87181611; exact revision not recorded

host.name: roman-dev-2
host.sharing: shared development host; not production hardware

data.journal: synthetic v3 journals from `txid-display-controller synth-journal`, genesis 5e5e...5e (never a real chain)
data.size_mix: about 90% inline (50-110 B), about 10% one page (7/8 within 129-528 B), about 0.1% 2-15 pages

publication.geometry: txid-2k (2,048 rows x 4,096 B, both tables)

workload.e2e: controller replay 25 blocks / 2 s; txid-rate 10 lookups/s requested, 64 workers, mix recent=0.8 archive=0.2, cold every 25, absent every 20; run 3 re-samples the natural fixture (400 + 50 absent) every 60 s
workload.bench: one recent-replica worker under systemd-run CPUQuota=100% (and 200%), MemoryMax=1536M, MemorySwapMax=0, TRANSPARENT_BUILD_THREADS=1 (and 2), cache 512 MiB, retain 1; controller replay 1 block / 12 s, 8 cycles per size
workload.bandwidth: txid-bandwidth measure through the TCP byte meter over plain HTTP/1.1, 3 samples per (tier, class, cold|warm)

commands.bench_worker: harness/recent-bench.sh BIN WORK OUT (STEP_MS=12000 CYCLES=8; fallback CPU_QUOTA=200% BUILD_THREADS=2)

outputs.local/e2e-run1: failed attempt retained (142 x 503 waiting places); handoff copy
outputs.local/e2e-run2: harness gap retained (single fixture; 1,961 missed slots)
outputs.local/ablation: per-configuration bootstrap, census and bandwidth; formula.json; ablation-summary.json

measured_vs_derived: Latency, cycle and freshness times, census counts and metered bytes are measured. Runtime bytes per txid use the plan's 75.5 MB per segment and are derived. Formula rows are computed.
limitations: synthetic chain and size mix; real mainnet packing may differ
loopback, plain HTTP: no TLS, router or WAN; not comparable to the 20 QPS production reference
freshness excludes node propagation and the router
acceptance: local stage only; production criteria remain open
